question: Parts of a tower crane and their functions?
text:
On a typical **horizontal-jib tower crane**, the **hoist** moves the load up and down, the **trolley** moves it toward or away from the tower, and the **slewing unit** swings it around the tower. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai))

| Part | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Base and foundation** | Support the crane and transfer its weight and overturning forces to the ground. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Mast (tower)** | The vertical steel structure that supports the upper assembly and gives the crane its height. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Slewing unit (turntable)** | Uses a large bearing and drive motors to rotate the upper assembly around the mast. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Jib (working arm)** | The long horizontal arm that supports the trolley and gives the crane its reach. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Trolley** | Travels along the jib, moving the suspended load closer to or farther from the mast. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hoist motor, drum, and wire rope** | The motor turns the drum to wind or unwind the rope, raising or lowering the hook. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hook block** | The hook-and-pulley assembly suspended from the hoist rope. The load attaches to the hook, usually through slings or other rigging. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Counter-jib** | The shorter arm opposite the working jib. It carries the counterweights and often the hoist machinery. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Counterweights** | Offset part of the overturning effect of the working jib and its load. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Operator’s cab and controls** | Let the operator control lifting, trolley travel, and rotation. Safety devices limit motions such as trolley travel and help prevent overloads. ([morrow.com](https://www.morrow.com/learn/tower-crane-101?utm_source=openai)) |

A **luffing-jib crane** changes its reach by pivoting the jib up or down rather than moving a trolley along a horizontal arm. ([govinfo.gov](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CFR-2024-title29-vol8/xhtml/CFR-2024-title29-vol8-part1926-subpartCC.html?utm_source=openai))
